title: Kanojo no Kanojo to Fujun na Hatsukoi

titleNative: 彼女のカノジョと不純な初恋
synonyms: My Guilty First Love With Another Girl's Girlfriend
synopsis: "In exchange for my help with your studies, you must stay let me stay at your house until summer vacation." If I get a failing mark again, my chance to live by myself will be over. So I'm forced to go along with the proposal from Tsukasa, the smartest and most beautiful girl in school. But then I saw them. I saw Tsukasa kissing a girl in the park. Tsukasa, who often annoys me with her abnormal invasions of my personal space, has a “girlfriend." Her yuri friend is against this arrangement because she thinks it's “cheating” even if it's between two girls, but Tsukasa is having none of it. After a while, my grades are improving and I'm beginning to enjoy living with Tsukasa. I know that “it's not cheating if you're not in love with them,” but… I'm okay with it. If I don't think about love, we can all get along and be happy, right? (Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

title: How to Love a Loser
synopsis: Shinba has no talent, no job, no money...he's a complete loser. However, he has a girlfriend, Hizumi who is beautiful, smart, good at her work. He has no idea why she says she likes him. He's almost scared, but loves Hizumi so much...he asks Hizumi, "Why do you want to date with someone like me?" She answers..."You always oversleep, talk about some video games I don't even know about, sing lame songs no one knows at karaoke, gave me a toy ring as a gift. Your face is always gloomy as hell. But...looking at such face makes me happy, Shinba. I love you, ha ha." Is she telling the truth? Hizumi must have some kind of a secret, Shinba thinks. He wants to find out...but maybe he shouldn't. (Source: BookWalker)

The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity - Kaoru & Rin
synopsis: This story takes place in a particular town with two infamous schools in constant dispute: Chidori High, a boys' school predominantly attended by low-class students with damning grades, and its neighbor Kikyo Girls' High, with most of its female students coming from wealthy and prestigious families. One day, high school second-year Rintaro Tsumugi, a fierce-looking but gentle-minded student at Chidori, is helping at his family's patisserie when he encounters a female customer by the name of Kaoruko Waguri. Rintaro enjoys his time with Kaoruko, as she doesn't judge him for his appearance, but this blissful peace is quickly disturbed when Rintaro makes the discovery that Kaoruko is actually a student at Kikyo. This revelation marks the beginning of the two's strenuous tale, as they fight against the limitations placed upon them by their schools and surroundings in an attempt to find their own path! (Source: K Manga)

title: DIG IT
synopsis: Gaku is the son of former Japanese national volleyball star Kei Shishiya. Through middle school, he's played as his team's ace hitter, though part of him wonders if that's a title he earned, or one he was simply given. One day, Kei meets Noboru, a generational volleyball talent with a monstrous spiking arm, and vows to turn him into the next national standout. In the wake of that choice, Gaku realizes he can't play the style his father demands, but swears he'll defeat both Kei and Noboru with a game that's entirely his own. (Source: K MANGA)

synopsis: “You’re less than garbage as a servant!” Gald, a boy working as a servant for an Earl’s family, is expelled one day. With nowhere to go, Gald decides to enroll in a magic academy, something he never did in his previous life. In his past life—Gald was the strongest sage in history! In the entrance examination for the world's most prestigious magic academy, Gald, a commoner, surpasses nobles who can only use intermediate-level magic, demonstrating mastery over the highest level of magic, overwhelming them! After enrolling, Gald continues to use his overwhelming power as a sage, defeating all enemies in the arena and dungeons alike, enjoying his academy life alongside two beautiful girls he met there, Yuri and Sasha.

title: NINE PEAKS
synopsis: Gaku Mashio was a first-year high school student who lived with his father. He lost his father in a sudden accident, just as he got suspended from school after getting into a fight. On the night of his father's wake, Gaku went fishing on the shore in memory of his father, but he fell into the sea and was returned 22 years into the past. Gaku's father, Harumi, who was the same age as Gaku at that time, saved him from the water. Harumi's parents (Gaku's grandparents) took a liking to Gaku, and accepted him into their family under the name Gaku Miyagi. His grandparents even encouraged him to go to Seiha High School, same as his father. Twenty-two years ago, the town of Kurei was full of delinquents. Now Gaku and his father will fight their way to the top of the town! (Source: Shonen Champion, translated)
